source_caption:
The Minions swap bananas for football boots as they hilariously represent France and England in a chaotic battle for third place. What starts as a friendly match quickly turns into complete mayhem, with outrageous tackles, own goals, bizarre celebrations, and plenty of slapstick comedy that only the Minions can deliver.

Packed with nonstop laughs, ridiculous antics, and their signature gibberish, the lovable yellow troublemakers transform a simple football match into an unforgettable spectacle where winning is almost an accident.

#Minions #France #England #Football #Comedy
